heroTitle: Traditional CRE systems are built to record the past, not navigate the future.
heroParagraphs: Most platforms function as expensive digital filing cabinets or “systems of record”. They show you where you’ve been providing descriptive dashboards capturing payments, work orders and lease details. But they fail to forecast impacts to your P&L, employee experience or enterprise risk.

C&D turns your data into a decision engine. By combining deep domain and data expertise specific to corporate real estate, we provide the 'connective tissue' between your daily operations and your board-room goals. We don't just organize your data; we optimize it to unlock capital, slash operational costs immediately, improve employee experience and reduce portfolio risks.

cta.title: Book a Portfolio Audit
cta.body: You are likely sitting on a goldmine of data trapped inside static, siloed systems. In 45 minutes, we will identify the bottlenecks keeping your team stuck in the past.
bullets: AI Readiness: A clear assessment of how prepared your architecture is for the next wave of automation.
The Integrity Gap: Pinpoint exactly which data sources are undermining your high-stakes decisions.
The CDM Shortcut: Discover how our Common Data Model bypasses the 24 months needed for data projects.
The ROI Roadmap: A prioritized list of optimization tasks that lead to immediate cost reduction and time savings.
